eps.d: One day in the woods Mr. Happy comes across Mr. Miserable and persuades him to turn his frown upside down.
This story follows Mr. Silly as he strives to win a certain competition.
Mr. Jelly goes for a stroll and on his way is terrified to see such things as a snake and a lion. Along the way, he is taught a couple of tricks not to be as nervous.
One year, Father Christmas get a little bit stuck at his busiest time of the year and needs Mr. Show help to do the rounds visiting all the girls and boys, to make sure they get all the right toys.
Mr. Bounce goes to see the Doctor to see if there's anything he can do to stop bouncing!
After getting up and going for a morning stroll, Mr. Forgetful bumps into a policeman, who gives him an important message to pass on. But will he remember it?
Mr. Funny visits the zoo, but when he gets there he is sad to see the animals are all rather miserable and need cheering up.
Will Mr. Bump ever get a job right for him? Not without a few additions to his bandages, that's for sure!
He just tickles people.
Mr. Small wants a job and Mr. Robinson is happy to help. Together they think of what Mr. Small might be able to do...
When Mr. Messy bumps into Mr. Tidy and Mr. Neat, no good can come of it!
One morning after eating an enormous breakfast, Mr. Greedy goes on a stroll and meets a giant who teaches him a lesson in his greedy ways!
When Mr. Sneeze goes to find a cure for his constant sneezing, he discovers that there might be a simple explanation for why he can't stop sneezing when he's at home in Shivertown.

Mr. Strong is so strong from eating many eggs, enough that he can break things, until he finds a farmer whose cornfield is on fire. Mr. Strong is so strong he picks up the farmer's barn and fills it with water, pours the water on the cornfield, extinguishing it. Mr. Strong is rewarded with eggs from the chickens on the farm.
When a little boy called Jack daydreamed as he usually does, Mr Daydream appeared before him and took him on an adventure on his giant flying bird.
Mr Fussy is so fussy that he would have to make sure that everything was all neat and tidy, and in its proper place.
Mr. Worry worries about everything. If it rains, he worries that his roof will leak, if there is no rain, he worries that all of his plants will die.
Mr. Uppity lives in Bigtown and he is very rich. He is rude to everybody (they call him Miserable old Uppity) until one day he meets a goblin.

Mr. Dizzy lives in Cleverland, where everybody is clever except for him - until, one day, because a pig and an elephant take advantage of him, he wishes himself clever as he drinks from a wishing well, despite being unaware of its magical properties.
Mr Topsy-Turvy is the most topsy-turviest person in the whole world. He is always getting things upside down and back to front.

Mr Muddle is an individual who can never get anything right. The simplest of things confuses him, such as putting on his coat and hammering in a nail into the wall. Mr Muddle even walks back to front!
Mr. Mean never spends a penny of his money. He is so mean he gives his brother a piece of coal for Christmas.
Mr. Nosey is so nosey that he is always putting his nose into other peoples business.
Mr. Chatterbox will talk on and on. He talks leaving the mailman late delivering all his mail, and causing Mr. Bowler, the hatter, to come home late to cold dinner.
Mr Noisy is the noisiest person in the world. When he sneezes you can hear him in the next country, and when he snores it sounds like a herd of elephants!
Nothing is impossible to Mr. Impossible. He can do anything. He has magic powers similar to Little Miss Magic and even uses his powers to motivate people.
Mr. Lazy is lazy, he lives in Sleepyland, where there are only four hours a day, as opposed to 24, and it takes two regular hours for water to boil and three regular hours for bread to toast.
Mr Grumpy is the grouchiest person in the world. He lives in Happyland, He's always in a bad mood, hating anyone or anything he comes across.
